methods.name: gfitCamera
methods.description:

methods.description:

 		The differences between model and fitted data. By definition,

 		If model has constant x0, then must be uncorrelated with constant

  			This will be used in predictive simulations

methods.name: unwrap_Cellstr
methods.description:
Recursively converts a nested cell array, numeric/logical array, or struct into a single human-readable string, used to serialize arbitrary parameter/metadata values (e.g. for logging or provenance text). For cell inputs, converts each element to a string (numeric/logical scalars via num2str, arrays wrapped in brackets, nested cells via recursive obj.unwrap_Cellstr(...) calls, other elements passed through as-is) and joins them with ', ', wrapping the whole result in curly braces.
For plain numeric/logical input, uses mat2str and wraps the result in square brackets; for a struct, recursively unwraps each field's value and prefixes it with the field name, joined with newline escapes; for anything else (e.g. char/string), passes it through obj.correctPathOS(C, 'mac') to normalize path separators.

				The idea is that we will be processing multiple files at once. Of course, we could do single files this way, too, instead of using Roadmap in the future
		data: a string, '3.x'

				nbins = depends on Mode
